madrid-sierra-de-guadarrama-mountain-day.title: Madrid · Sierra de Guadarrama Mountain Day
madrid-sierra-de-guadarrama-mountain-day.slogan: A 166 km loop out of Navacerrada Pass
madrid-sierra-de-guadarrama-mountain-day.story: High plateau air and historic stops north of the city. 166 km round from Cercedilla - plan on about 3 h 12 of riding. It goes by way of Segovia old town, La Granja palace and Rascafría. Navacerrada Pass is the high point. It tops out at about 1,350 m. The passes are the reason to go.
madrid-sierra-de-guadarrama-mountain-day.hero: Madrid · Sierra de Guadarrama Mountain Day

sections.advice: La Granja palace → Rascafría food is the reward section in Madrid. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.title: Navacerrada Pass → Segovia old town
scenicChapters.narrative: 56 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 29 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
